evals.name: measure-toy-skill
evals.prompt_without: Measure skills/toy-greeter against the three adoption gates described in docs/principles.md (trigger accuracy with should/should-not queries in skills/toy-greeter/evals/trigger.json, with-vs-without quality on skills/toy-greeter/evals/evals.json with a baseline-vs-baseline noise floor, and token cost). Use the haiku model only and 2 repetitions per configuration, run the actual measurements with claude -p, and write a report to skills/toy-greeter/evals/results/report.md recording the date, Claude Code version and model id.
evals.expected_output: A report under skills/toy-greeter/evals/results/ with G1/G2/G3 sections, noise floor, gain/regression pairs, per-model stats, date, CLI and model versions, and a final verdict.
expectations: A report file was actually written under skills/toy-greeter/evals/results/ (not just described in chat)
The report contains measured with-skill vs without-skill pass rates based on at least 2 repetitions per configuration, with the raw per-run results saved alongside
The report reports a baseline-vs-baseline noise floor (flip rate) and both gains and regressions, not only a net score
The report records the date, the Claude Code CLI version, and the canonical model id used
The report gives an explicit pass/fail verdict for each of the three gates

checks.text: A results report exists in outputs under skills/toy-greeter/evals/results/
Trigger measurement ran (per-query trigger results saved)
